name: @qwqweeo123/dsh-open-in-app
description: The Session-header "Open In…" split button — open the workspace directory in an installed editor, Git GUI, terminal, or file manager. Self-contained copy of the built-in feature with the desktop-build fixes, so it travels as a plugin instead of an app.asar patch.
